raw_text: Driving from Philadelphia to uptown Manhattan on the day of the World Cup Final. I need to drive from Philadelphia to uptown Manhattan during or after the World Cup final at the Meadowlands. I am a local, and have driven from Philly to NYC literally hundreds of times, but in the past I was always able to just choose when I drove, to avoid rush hour and events like this. Now I’m in a situation where I don’t have that luxury (plans made without realizing the World Cup schedule, obviously), and I’m not sure what my best bet is. While I’ve done the trip a lot, I have never done it regularly, and so I don’t really know traffic and congestion patterns beyond the basics. How early I can leave will depend on the weather, but going by current forecasts, we’ll probably be unable to leave Philadelphia before 3pm or possibly even later. If the weather changes, we might be able to leave earlier, but it seems likely that this will only help if we leave quite early, which will be challenging. How late I can arrive is somewhat more flexible, but later than 10pm would be very disruptive and likely unpleasant. Normally I’d much prefer substantially before that. So leaving Philly at 8pm is not really a good solution here, unless the consensus is that leaving earlier is just going to run into so much traffic that it won’t get us to the destination any sooner. Honestly, I’m not even sure that 8pm will be late enough .
